trust_decision.summary: Three checks decide which clients may write story source through the dev server. The bind address and the Host/Origin check decide who can load the pages that carry the WebSocket token. The WS upgrade lets any token holder send any channel event. The save-story handler then turns client-supplied names, arg keys and importPath into source written to disk, with no validation.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'devices on the same network', so an engineer looks first at the listen call. It passes options.host straight through, so an unset host binds to all interfaces.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the Storybook dev server and its WebSocket token. Vitest's browser API is a third-party test-runner server with its own defaults and no token. The MCP endpoint is an opt-in addon whose clients are not browsers. A solver can argue that neither is 'the dev server'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Several legitimate behaviours must keep working. `--host 0.0.0.0` with empty allowedHosts (Docker) must still allow all hosts. Non-browser clients (tools SDK, MCP clients) send no Origin and no `page`, and authenticate with the token alone. localhost subdomains and the machine's own interface IPs stay valid origins. The 'default' export sentinel and legitimate new story names must still save. An over-broad fix (reject Origin-less clients, drop IP hosts, require loopback only) breaks Docker, the tools SDK and MCP agents.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The feature exists on the 8.x/9.x/10.x lines and was dropped from next. A maintainer restoring it would wire it into this same experimental_serverChannel list next to initializeSaveStory.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A channel handler that writes a client payload into .storybook/main.ts. Today it writes only a literal through ConfigFile.set/valueToNode; a sibling could emit the payload as an expression or path instead.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already writes a project source file from a manager event with no type check on the payload. One extra config toggle written as an expression is a plausible maintainer change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A rename after the check: the new export identifier is assigned on the cloned AST after save-story validated `name`. A sibling deriving it from storyNameFromExport or csfId would bypass the identifier check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: save-story.ts:73-75 already derives newStoryName/newStoryId from `name` and `csfId`. Using a derived value for the binding is a natural refactor (how-type parser differential).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second copy of the '0.0.0.0 means allow all hosts' rule, feeding Vite's own allowedHosts for HMR on the same server.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It duplicates getHostValidationMiddleware.ts:37 in another package. A planted divergent copy, for example one keyed on an empty host, is a realistic drift.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Bind the dev server to localhost by default and stop. That leaves IP-literal Origins accepted by isValidHost, any token holder able to send any event, save-story names/arg keys/importPath unvalidated, MCP without an Origin check, and the Vitest API writable.
